# ContextOS Project Operating System Rules

<!-- CORE_PROJECT_CONTRACT_MARKER_V2 -->

## Step 0 - Identify Before Acting
Declare domain, phase, and specialist role before each major phase.

## Non-Negotiable Rules
1. Zero-Assumption Investigation: Inspect code before modifying.
2. Zero-Placeholder Production Code: Never emit TODO stubs or incomplete code.
3. Mandatory Proof-of-Work Verification: Run tests before reporting completion.
4. Surgical Blast Radius Containment: Modify only required files.
